# Blacksmith

## Docs

- [Data Processing Addendum](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/about/data-processing-addendum.md)
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/about/privacy-policy.md)
- [Sub-processors](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/about/sub-processors.md)
- [Support Terms](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/about/support-terms.md)
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/about/terms-of-service.md)
- [Network & IP Allowlisting](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-administration/network-allowlisting.md): Control plane IPs to allowlist in GitHub for Blacksmith to register runners
- [Permissions](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-administration/permissions.md): How GitHub permissions map to Blacksmith access
- [Scale Apps](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-administration/scale-apps.md): Auxiliary GitHub Apps that raise per-org rate-limit headroom for runner provisioning
- [Actions](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-caching/dependencies-actions.md): Blacksmith automatically caches your dependencies to speed up your workflows
- [Sticky Disks](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-caching/dependencies-sticky-disks.md): Blacksmith optionally offers Sticky Disks to speed up your workflows
- [40x Faster Docker Builds](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-caching/docker-builds.md): Blacksmith optionally caches your Docker layers to speed up your workflows
- [Faster Container Init](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-caching/docker-container-caching.md): Blacksmith pre-hydrates service containers to eliminate pull and extraction overhead
- [Git Checkout Caching (Beta)](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-caching/git-checkout-caching.md): Cache git repositories on sticky disks to eliminate full clones on every workflow run
- [CI Analytics](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/dashboard.md): Fastest way to monitor your GitHub Actions performance and costs across your team
- [Run History](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/history.md): Fastest way to search, filter, and debug past CI runs on Blacksmith runners
- [Logs](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/logs.md): Fastest way to search and filter logs across all CI jobs running on Blacksmith runners
- [Metrics](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/metrics.md): Easiest way to monitor machine metrics on Blacksmith runners
- [Monitors](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/monitors.md): The fastest way to debug your CI jobs
- [SSH Access](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/ssh-access.md): Fastest way to debug running jobs and inspect VM state
- [Test Analytics](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-observability/test-analytics.md): Easiest way to monitor your test suite health across your team
- [Instance Types](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-runners/overview.md): Blacksmith runners are 2x faster and costs 75% less than GitHub-hosted runners
- [Static IP](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-runners/static-ip.md): Use Blacksmith runners with a dedicated static IP
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-testbox/cli.md): Testbox CLI commands and flags
- [Testboxes (Beta)](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/blacksmith-testbox/overview.md): Let coding agents run CI against local changes, instantly
- [Quickstart](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/introduction/quickstart.md): Try the fastest way to run your GitHub Actions in under 5 minutes
- [Settings](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/introduction/settings.md): Learn more about the Blacksmith Settings page
- [Welcome](https://docs.blacksmith.sh/introduction/why-blacksmith.md): The fastest way to run your GitHub Actions
